newsitem.title: USA: AMPAC, Galaxy enter China venture.
newsitem.headline: AMPAC, Galaxy enter China venture.

text.p: AMPAC International Inc said that it, Galaxy Foods Co and Huzhou Zhenyuantong Foods Mfy entered a tentative deal for a joint venture that will produce, sell and distribute various food products in China.
The partners determined that total initial investment for the joint venture will reach an estimated $15 million, while registered capital will be $4.5 million, AMPAC said.
The company said the venture will be headquartered in Huzhou, a transportation and manufacturing hub close to several of China's major markets, including Shanghai.
The venture will be closed subject to due diligence, AMPAC said.
Under terms of the agreement, AMPAC's Pacific Foods subsidiary will hold a 65 percent interest in the venture.
Huzhou Zhenyuantong, owner of a 35 percent interest, will provide factory premises, equipment, labor and installation of equipment.

Galaxy Foods will negotiate with suppliers regarding the purchase of equipment technology, contribute the formulations for the various food products, conduct research and development for new products, train employees and provide consulting to the venture, AMPAC said.
